text:
alex: quick heads-up — ran a 30m profile on /v1/embeddings/rerank after the kernel selector change (kernel v2.3 -> v2.4). saw a small but suspicious 95p shift on p99 for the reranker. attaching quick notes.

maria: thanks. can you share the perf breakdown? is it before or after batching heuristic tweak?

alex: this is post-heuristic tweak (auto-batch: target=64 -> 48 for short sequences). main summary: QPS stable, tail latency up ~30ms p99, token-level decode time increased ~12ms, KV lookup time slightly decreased. KV hit rate down 2.3% for rerank route.

jin: do you have the PromQL + sample numbers?

alex: pasted snaps below. used perf-bot traces + prom queries.

alex: ```promql
# 5m rolling 95th token latency by stage
sum(rate(redwood_inference_token_latency_seconds_sum{route="/v1/embeddings/rerank"}[5m])) by (stage)
/ sum(rate(redwood_inference_token_latency_seconds_count{route="/v1/embeddings/rerank"}[5m])) by (stage)
```

alex: sample (5m window, 2026-11-01T13:02):
- tokenization: 0.9ms -> unchanged
- forward-attention: 8.1ms -> unchanged
- kv-lookup: 1.4ms -> -0.6ms
- kv-insert: 0.8ms -> +0.2ms
- decode: 11.7ms -> +12.3ms

rachel: decode jumping that much smells like kernel switch ended up picking a vectorized path that's slower for short dims. what model/quantization?

alex: model: open-rerank-6B-8bit, vector dim=1536, avg seq len=28 tokens. kernel selector picked fused-gemm-v2 for the attention stage and a new decoder output kernel for int8 that we rolled in last week.

maria: KV hit drop 2.3% — any change in prefix cache TTL or routing?

alex: no TTL change. but batching heuristic reduction (64->48) increases chance of splitting requests across batches, which can reduce effective prefix sharing across requests. hypothesize: fewer co-batched requests leads to slightly fewer KV hits per batch.

jin: can we correlate kv_hit_ratio with batch size distribution? try this promql: ```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_batch_size_bucket{route="/v1/embeddings/rerank"}[10m])) by (le))
```

rachel: also check per-route model selection fallback events — maybe some requests hit a fallback model that has different kernel mapping.

alex: good point. perf-bot trace says ~0.6% of requests fell back to rerank-6B-compat which uses a different decoder kernel.

maria: OK, action items:
1) add token-level breakdown panel to rerank route dashboard (tokenization, attention, kv-lookup, kv-insert, decode) with absolute ms and relative pct.
2) add batch-size distribution heatmap for the route (2h/6h windows).
3) alert: if p99 decode increases >20ms over baseline for 10m -> trigger perf regression ticket.
4) run A/B with old kernel selector on a 5% traffic slice for 24h to confirm.

jin: I'll add the prom queries & panel configs to the dashboard PR. will include kube tags and model_version label.

alex: dropping queries here for the dashboard cards:```promql
# decode p95/p99 for rerank route
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_decode_token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/embeddings/rerank"}[5m])) by (le))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_decode_token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/embeddings/rerank"}[5m])) by (le))

# kv hit ratio
sum(rate(redwood_kv_cache_hits_total{route="/v1/embeddings/rerank"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(redwood_kv_cache_lookups_total{route="/v1/embeddings/rerank"}[5m]))

# QPS by model_version
sum(rate(redwood_requests_total{route="/v1/embeddings/rerank"}[1m])) by (model_version)

# batch size distribution
sum(rate(redwood_batch_size_bucket{route="/v1/embeddings/rerank"}[10m])) by (le)
```

rachel: also surface vector dim in the route header so Ops can filter heatmaps by dim; certain kernels prefer divisible dims and we need to know if 1536 triggers a different microkernel path.

maria: good call. add label vector_dim to all inference metrics for rerank endpoints. keep it optional for other routes.

alex: follow-ups: I'm scheduling the 5% A/B tomorrow 09:00 UTC; will collect 24h traces and run the perf-diff tool (perf-diff --baseline=kernel-2.3 --candidate=kernel-2.4).

perf-bot: scheduled A/B test started (id=ab-9832), slice=5%, route=/v1/embeddings/rerank, start=2026-11-02T09:00:00Z

jin: ping me when traces are in, I'll template dashboard panels and the alert rule.

maria: thanks team — this is the kind of instrumentation we needed. keep short notes in the ticket and we'll evaluate rollback if perf-diff shows regression > 10% p99. :thumbsup:

alex: will do, adding notes to #perf-regressions ticket and will paste final graphs.
